m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You seek the Master, the one you call Khan? A hard journey lies before you. Khan dwells on the other side of the Jungle, where we never go!
The Master lives in an ancient Tower. It was home to Sycorax the Storm Witch until the Master defeated her. There is no way in!
I'll be the judge of that. Let's go take a look, Wizard!
There's no way across - we can't reach the Tower!
Greetings, Pork! I see you escaped the Beastmen. Valiant, but too late.
I have built a ship of my own, with a Cyclolabe to steer it. All I needed to escape this place was a Lux Capacitor, and I have taken yours! Farewell.
We've got to make a bridge or something - if Khan leaves we'll never get to Zanadu!
You seek to enter the Tower of Sycorax?
Khan stole our Lux Capacitor! If we don't get it back we're stuck on this island. You need to find Khan's Tower right away.
While you were gone somebody must have snuck on board. They got the jump on me and Sparck! I didn't see who it was - they hit me from behind.
When I woke up Sparck was gone - and the Lux Capacitor too! If we don't get it back we're stuck here.
Inside voice, Captain. Look, if we're going to get to Zanadu, or anywhere, we need that Lux Capacitor back!
And we still need a Cyclolabe to boot! We need to find Khan's Tower. Maybe the castaways can help.
Be careful, James! You too, Wizard.
